name: slop-guard
description: Prevents, detects and gates security, performance and maintainability anti-patterns in agent-written code.

interface.shortDescription: Security and quality gate for agent-written code
interface.longDescription: Prevents, detects and gates security, performance and maintainability anti-patterns. Enforces linter-suppression justifications, blocks supply-chain installs, denies credential file access, detects hard-coded secrets, and gates quality-config lowering — across Claude Code, Codex, and Grok.

stop_gate.title: Block turn end on unresolved blockers
stop_gate.description: Run slow checks at Stop and keep agent working while blockers remain.
